deploy-bot: Staging cutover sequence started for tag release/rc-1.9.2 (sha: a1b2c3d). Environment: staging. Change window: maintenance-2026-03-21-20:00 UTC. Canary traffic initially at 5%.

tess: Copy — I'll monitor canary dashboards and alerting.

omar: Tailing runtime + sidecar logs now: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime -f --since=2m`

lucy: Canary traffic shift at 5% -> p50 latency ~48ms, p95 ~220ms, no 5xx spikes. :white_check_mark:

maria: Observability check: traces show no novel error classes, alert thresholds set (500s > 1%).

tess: Safety rule: if 5xx > 2% over 10m or p50 > 200ms sustained -> rollback. @deploy-bot set hold-on-failure=true.

deploy-bot: Canary healthchecks: pass=24 fail=0, infra checks OK. Auto-shift scheduled in 10m unless pinned.

omar: Noting 2 reranker pods showing slow readiness for their first startup (one stuck at 18s). Registering a temporary probe tweak.

lucy: Pushed a quick probe patch (readiness timeout 30s -> 60s) to the staging rollout plan to avoid noisy failures. Patch does not change image.

tess: Thanks — please annotate the runbook with that probe change so QA knows.

maria: Added note to release notes draft: "mitigated reranker startup flakiness by increasing readiness timeout".

deploy-bot: Canary health stable for 12m; rolling to 25% now. No escalations.

lucy: Metrics after 25% shift: p50 52ms, p95 210ms, errors 0.7%. All good so far.

tess: Requesting pin to previous tag if p50 spikes above 250ms in the next 8m.

omar: Agree — will prepare pin command ready: `deployctl pin --env=staging --tag=release/rc-1.9.1 --reason="rollback readiness"`

deploy-bot: Final traffic shift complete: traffic at 100% on release/rc-1.9.2. Post-cut checks passed.

tess: Great — logging completion and updating changelog. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/staging/6009871234 (internal).

maria: Pushing release notes to google doc, will circle back for any follow-ups.

lucy: Leaving a short note in SRE channel about the probe tweak in case it affects local dev.

deploy-bot: STAGING CUTOVER COMPLETE — tag=release/rc-1.9.2, commit=a1b2c3d, duration=~18m, status=SUCCESS :tada:

tess: Thanks everyone. Watch window for 1 hour; if no regressions we'll promote this build to the canary pool for dedicated later this week.

omar: 👍

maria: :white_check_mark:
